findings.title: Player left permanently embedded in terrain at a settled world-fight site (hard-stuck, no in-product recovery)
repro: 1. Walk a character to a mob pack in VERDANT HOLLOW and press [R] to engage a public world fight.
2. Let the fight resolve (here: both seats forfeited through the product's FORFEIT + confirm dialog).
3. Dismiss the fight report (CONTINUE). Observe the character's world position.
OBSERVED: the character stands at the old fight site at y=138 while the pre-fight ground there was y=133 — the camera renders solid voxels at point-blank range and the character model is not visible.

mechanical_pin.note: ALL of KeyW/KeyS/KeyA/KeyD held 1.5s each produced dx=0, dz=0, dy=0. Space+KeyW also produced zero on every axis — the character cannot even fall, i.e. fully encased, not merely blocked.

findings.persistence: Survived 3 independent fresh browser boots (3 separate contexts, ~10 minutes apart). Not a client hang: HUD at 46 FPS, HP 70/70, chat live, prompts responsive, wallet panel live.
findings.contrast: bob, in the SAME session and build, calibrated and walked normally (W→(0,-13), D→(11,0)). Earlier in the run alice herself walked normally from (-468,-389) BEFORE the fight — the immobility begins only after the fight at that site settles.
findings.impact: A player who finishes a world fight can be permanently unable to move. No unstuck affordance is offered; jump does not free them. The only apparent escape is the TRAVEL modal (world change), which was not exercised.
findings.blocks: BAR 4 attempt A — alice could not walk to a pack to engage a fresh fight.

findings.title: Joining seat's client does not mount the placement board during the placement window
findings.observed: Bob clicked JOIN in FIGHTS IN RANGE; chain seated him (participants seat 1) within seconds. ~13s later his client still showed the OVERWORLD with only a FORFEIT button — no placement board, no fighters, no timeline. __ARES_DEV_PLACE_READY refused with "my fighter not in slice" and DEV_STATE had my_cell:null, my_hp:null while alice's client already had my_cell {1,0}.
findings.consequence: Bob never placed or readied. The chain force-started the fight at the placement deadline, so bob was auto-placed and lost his placement turn — a coop seat silently forfeits its positioning.
findings.resolves: NOT permanent — after a fresh boot resuming the same fight ACTIVE, bob's client folded his seat correctly (my_cell {2,0}, hp 66/70) and both clients rendered both names. So this is a PLACEMENT-WINDOW fold latency, not a lost seat.

findings.title: Honest error surfacing on an expired turn
findings.console: [fight] expired turn could not be advanced {fight_id, status:1, turn_deadline_ms, active_entity_id: bob, my_entity_id: alice}
findings.attribution: Caused by THIS drive: the fight sat past its turn deadline for ~4 minutes while the rig was being repaired between attempts. Not a product defect — the client surfaced the condition instead of failing silently.

bar4_escalation_brief.SYMPTOM: BAR 4 (hard-refresh ONE client mid-PLACEMENT on the coop path) never reached its measurement window.
bar4_escalation_brief.REPRO: Two independent attempts, both stopped before a coop placement board existed to refresh.
TRIED: Attempt A (mcd_bar4.mjs, alice engages): alice is hard-stuck in terrain at the previous fight site (finding F1) — she stalled 34 blocks from the nearest pack and the [R] ATTACK prompt never armed. Disproved "the client was merely showing a modal": a fresh boot with a clean, readable HUD still produced zero movement on all axes.

Attempt B (mcd_bar4b.mjs, roles inverted — bob engages a pack 34 blocks from alice so her 50-block [V] prompt would arm without walking): bob reached the pack (d=4), his ATTACK prompt armed (attack=true), separation A-B 31, but his [R] produced NO fight on /v1 within 150s. Disproved "alice's immobility is the only blocker" — the engage itself did not fire for bob at that pack.
bar4_escalation_brief.HYPOTHESIS: Two independent causes. F1 immobilises any seat that settled a fight at a site. For attempt B, the most likely cause is that focus_world() clicks the canvas centre-bottom to hand keyboard focus to the game, and that click may have re-targeted or de-armed the ATTACK prompt between the arm check and the [R] press; a second possibility is a silent engage refusal on a pack whose spawn was already consumed. EVIDENCE GAP: no screenshot was taken between bob's arm check and his [R] press, and no console line was captured for a refused engage.
bar4_escalation_brief.SMALLEST_QUESTION: On the served build, does a world-fight engage [R] ever silently no-op after the ATTACK prompt has armed — and if so, does it emit any console line? A single-seat rig that screenshots + dumps console immediately before and after [R] answers it in one run.
bar4_escalation_brief.NOTE: BAR 4 was independently verified GREEN on the SOLO path in the PR-934 run (placement re-entry after two hard refreshes). Only the COOP variant is unproven here.
